lead: Create tags, merge duplicates and delete unused tags to keep search clean.
hint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, dots, + and #. 30 characters at most.
emptyHint: Change the search or create a tag.
deleteDisabled: A tag in use cannot be deleted: merge it instead
deleteText: Delete “{{name}}”? It is not used anywhere.
mergeLead: Everything tagged “{{name}}” will move to the chosen tag, then “{{name}}” will disappear.
mergeHint: Exact name of the tag to keep.
